title: UK AI Minister Kanishka Narayan says AI is set to add £55B to £140B to the economy by 2030, below a £400B estimate from a Google-led report touted by officials (Ben Gartside/Wired)
summary: Ben Gartside / Wired: UK AI Minister Kanishka Narayan says AI is set to add £55B to £140B to the economy by 2030, below a £400B estimate from a Google-led report touted by officials — The AI minister now concedes the estimated figure is less than a third of that. Researchers blame the country's slow rate of adoption
contentText:
Ben Gartside / Wired :

UK AI Minister Kanishka Narayan says AI is set to add £55B to £140B to the economy by 2030, below a £400B estimate from a Google-led report touted by officials   —  The AI minister now concedes the estimated figure is less than a third of that.  Researchers blame the country's slow rate of adoption
